blocks.name: Minor in Ethics in Society - General Track

rules.name: Foundational Courses (Part 1)
rules.notes: Must be taken for a letter grade, and for 4-5 units each.

rules.name: Foundational Courses (Part 2)
rules.notes: Must be taken for a letter grade, and for 4-5 units each.

rules.name: ETHICSOC Electives
rules.notes: Courses must be taken for a letter grade, and be a minimum of 3 units each.
rules.desc: Two or three ETHICSOC courses totaling a minimum of 8 units at the 100-level or above relating to the minor’s theme.

rules.name: University-Wide Electives
rules.notes:
Students are encouraged to reflect on the coherence of their coursework and organize it around a central theme, such as environmental ethics, ethics and public policy, ethics and economics, ethics and health care, ethics, race, etc. Ethical Reasoning courses that fit the student’s thematic focus may be counted towards the University-wide electives in the minor.
Courses must be taken for a letter grade, and be a minimum of 3 units each.
rules.desc: Two or three courses at the 100-level or above totaling a minimum of 8 units that address moral or political problems, in either theory or practice, relating to the student’s chosen focus. These may be other ETHICSOC offerings OR courses with substantial ethical content in other university departments.

blocks.notes: Elective/specialization course choices must be reviewed and approved for counting towards the program with the Student Services Specialist. Syllabi/relevant coursework may be requested for this review process.

blocks.name: Minor in Ethics in Society - Ethics and Technology Subplan

rules.name: Foundational Courses (Part 1)
rules.notes: Courses must be taken for a letter grade and must be 4-5 units each.

rules.name: Foundational Courses (Part 2)
rules.desc: One course in ethics and technology:
rules.notes: Course must be taken for a letter grade and must be 4-5 units.

rules.name: ETHICSOC Elective
rules.notes: Must be taken for a letter grade and must be 4-5 units.
rules.desc: One ETHICSOC elective at the 100 level or above.

rules.name: Ethics & Technology Electives
rules.desc: Three electives that cover various topics on technology, human values, and social impact from an interdisciplinary perspective. This is not an exhaustive list of all courses that could count towards the E&T electives, other courses must be submitted to the Student Services Specialist for approval.
rules.notes: Courses must be taken for a letter grade, must be at least 3 units each, and must total to a minimum of 8 units.
